title: [snappi][bug]: Unused old snappi fixture causing testcase to skip.
author: amitpawar12
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Testcase: tests/snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_pause_lossy_with_snappi.py

This particular test case is importing following functions from snappi_fixtures.py file:
```
from tests.snappi_tests.files.helper import reboot_duts, setup_ports_and_dut, multidut_port_info  # noqa: F401
```

The snappi infrastructure is already migrated to use "tgen_port_info" to find the list of static or dynamic ports for the test. In case of static port selection, this function uses snappi_tests/variables.override.yml file to select the ports.

But the above testcase imports the old setup_ports_and_dut pytest fixture which reads snappi_tests/variables.py file and since nothing is defined there, simply skips the testcase.


### Steps to Reproduce

Execute following testcase - tests/snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_pause_lossy_with_snappi.py

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior:
Since the unused old functions are imported, the old functions checks variables.py file to find the ports.

Expected behavior:
The import should be removed, instead testcase should rely on 'tgen_port_info' to find the relevant test ports.

```

comments.author: Bojun-Feng
comments.body:
Hi @amitpawar12, thanks for filing this. I just looked at this and seems like the scope is larger than the single file mentioned.

[`test_pfc_pause_lossy_with_snappi.py`](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_pause_lossy_with_snappi.py#L14) is an example of stale import. `setup_ports_and_dut` and `multidut_port_info` are imported but never actually used in test logic. Removing them from the import is straightforward.

However, multiple other files have the same import for the old `setup_ports_and_dut` in their test function signatures and bodies. I believe some of them can't be fixed by simply removing the import — they need to be migrated to `tgen_port_info`:

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/ecn/test_ecn_marking_with_snappi.py#L12 
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/ecn/test_ecn_marking_with_pfc_quanta_variance_with_snappi.py#L13
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/ecn/test_bp_fabric_ecn_marking_with_snappi.py#L13
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/ecn/test_ecn_marking_cisco8000.py#L14
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/b9f87bddee076856a66ddf7ccf68156ae4e6e72e/tests/snappi_tests/pfcwd/test_pfcwd_actions.py#L18

All of them import `setup_ports_and_dut`, which parametrizes against hardcoded hostnames in `variables.py`. But some are still structurally dependent on the old fixture's return values (`testbed_config`, `port_config_list`, `snappi_ports = setup_ports_and_dut`), so they'll need actual migration work to `tgen_port_info`, not just import removal.

`test_pfcwd_actions.py` in particular is heavily coupled — 14 references to `setup_ports_and_dut` and 12 to `multidut_port_info` across multiple test functions and parametrize decorators.

Might be worth expanding the scope of this issue (or filing a follow-up) to track the full migration. Is there already an issue tracking something similar?

comments.author: amitpawar12
comments.body:
For test_pfcwd_actions.py - I have this following issue open (#22473) and I am working on it.

There is similar test case test_pfcwd_basic.py which also needs to be addressed. The ECN testcases, you mentioned above are Cisco testcases, and I will ask them if they can work on it.

I am trying to get everything in one single direction ; to use tgen_port_info so that redundant functions can be removed.

Testcase: tests/snappi_tests/pfc/test_pfc_pause_lossy_with_snappi.py

This particular test case is importing following functions from snappi_fixtures.py file:

```
from tests.snappi_tests.files.helper import reboot_duts, setup_ports_and_dut, multidut_port_info  # noqa: F401
```

The snappi infrastructure is already migrated to use "tgen_port_info" to find the list of static or dynamic ports for the test. In case of static port selection, this function uses snappi_tests/variables.override.yml file to select the ports.

But the above testcase imports the old setup_ports_and_dut pytest fixture which reads snappi_tests/variables.py file and since nothing is defined there, simply skips the testcase.

Following fixes are added:
- Remove the unnecessary imports (setup_dut_ports and multidut_port_info) from the pfc_pause_lossy testcase.
- modify the function reboot_duts in snappi_tests/files/helper.py to use tgen_port_info as well.
- reboot_duts will choose setup_dut_ports or tgen_port_info depending on what is being used to select the ports.
- Once the setup_dut_port is completely removed, the reboot_duts will require change to ONLY use tgen_port_info.
- remove the try: <test> finally: <cleanup> and associated cleanup function from the test.
- Clean-up should be taken care by tgen_port_info function itself now.

Summary:
Fixes #22885

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
There is an unwanted "import setup_ports_and_dut, multidut_port_info" in the pfc_pause_lossy testcase. This testcase reads the variables.py file to determine the port for the test.

This is not required as tgen_port_info is introduced to select static/dynamic ports for the test. In case of static ports, it reads the port-info from variables.override.yml file.

#### How did you do it?
Removed the unrequired imports.

```
